hooks.name: gitignore-guard
hooks.description: After .gitignore is saved, asks the agent to check that .kiro is not ignored and to undo the line if it is.

action.prompt: You just changed .gitignore. Run: git check-ignore -v .kiro/steering/clinical-context.md .kiro/settings/mcp.json. If it prints anything, undo the line that ignores .kiro, because the .kiro folder must stay in the repo.
